title: Input symbol at an indexed position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $q$ be an optional mapping-machine state, let $i\le |x|$, let $a,b$ be Boolean words, let $h_a,h_b$ be integers, and let $out$ be a Boolean word. In the configuration with input head at position $i+1$ and these tape words, head positions, state, and output, the symbol under the input head is the $i$-th symbol of $x$, or blank if $i=|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
q is an optional mapping-machine state
i is a natural number with i ≤ |x|
a and b are Boolean words
